g.text: TPS22965 CT 470 pF / 25 V gives about 0.65 ms typical 3.3 V rise at 5 V bias; not a guaranteed timing bound.

g.desc: TPS22965 CT 470 pF / 25 V gives about 0.65 ms typical 3.3 V rise at 5 V bias; not a guaranteed timing bound.

g.text: FPGA FIXED CORE / SEQUENCED AUXILIARY AND I/O - ENGINEERING DRAFT

g.desc: FPGA FIXED CORE / SEQUENCED AUXILIARY AND I/O - ENGINEERING DRAFT

g.text: FPGA VCCX, all banks, flash and oscillator use switched +3V3_FPGA; per-pin and PLL bypass are on the bare FPGA sheet.

g.desc: FPGA VCCX, all banks, flash and oscillator use switched +3V3_FPGA; per-pin and PLL bypass are on the bare FPGA sheet.

g.text: TLV62569DBVR from 5 V; nominal core 1.0086 V. Never connect this rail to ESP32-P4 variable HP core.

g.desc: TLV62569DBVR from 5 V; nominal core 1.0086 V. Never connect this rail to ESP32-P4 variable HP core.

g.text: Chosen core-first qualification; VCCX/IO share switched rail. UG206-1.9.3E: core first for >10 ms rail ramps.

g.desc: Chosen core-first qualification; VCCX/IO share switched rail. UG206-1.9.3E: core first for >10 ms rail ramps.

g.text: Verify load/ramp/dropout, low-power reset, shutdown and MCU/JTAG backfeed. Falling hysteresis has no guaranteed bound.

g.desc: Verify load/ramp/dropout, low-power reset, shutdown and MCU/JTAG backfeed. Falling hysteresis has no guaranteed bound.

g.text: FPGA_IO_EN uses equal 10k pullup/pulldown for ~1.65 V HIGH; assert only after core sense release and delay.

g.desc: FPGA_IO_EN uses equal 10k pullup/pulldown for ~1.65 V HIGH; assert only after core sense release and delay.
